Growing up I would read a lot of comics with people saying things like, "Hold the anchovies!" I always thought it was weird and tried ordering pizzas with anchovies but nobody seems to do that anymore. I was food shopping yesterday and noticed a small jar of anchovies marked for quick sale, I already had a pizza in my basket (store-made meat lovers) and figured what the hell. When I got home I placed the fish on half of the pizza and cooked it. It actually wasn't half bad at all. It was really really salty, but somehow went perfect with beer. I'm a convert, I don't eat pizza very often, but i don't think I'll ever cook another one without anchovies.
